name: EasyFirmwareOpening
description: Container Browser support for embedded/mobile firmware container formats — Pixel/Tensor vendor blobs (FBPACK, ext4, EROFS, Shannon baseband TOC, Android boot images) and beyond, built to scale to hundreds of formats with one small file each.
longdescription: Adds Container Browser transforms for firmware container/filesystem formats, including Pixel/Tensor images and router firmware. A Rust backend handles DTBO, NETGEAR CHK, Broadcom TRX, LZMA-alone and SquashFS v4/XZ, including the complete R7000 extraction chain. Build it with cargo build --release; other formats remain Python. No external extraction program is required at runtime. See README.md and docs/ADDING_A_FORMAT.md.
author: Bradley Fernandez
